<objective>
Cross-dimensional codebase audit orchestrator — classify repo shape, fan out parallel read-only audit agents, dedup and severity-rank findings against existing issues, publish grouped tracking issues

Phases:

- classify: Determine repo shape and select applicable audit dimensions
- fanout: Dispatch parallel read-only audit agents, one per dimension, composing existing skills
- verify: Adversarial confirmation of HIGH findings by a second agent
- dedup: Merge cross-dimension duplicates, severity-rank, cross-check against existing issues
- publish: File grouped thematic tracking issues with checkbox action lists (or emit ranked report)
- remediate: Optional fix fan-out — worktree-isolated fix agents, one per theme, gated on human confirmation (optional)
  </objective>
